explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/103: h(n) counts incongruent sets of n points in ℝ² minimizing diameter subject to d(x,y)≥1, and asks h(n)→∞. IsSeparated' is pairwise ≥1, and Congruent uses an isometry of the plane. h as a sup over finite pairwise-incongruent families in ℕ∞ handles possible infinitude, and tending to ⊤ is the right limit there. Faithful.
